bullets.text: UK Partners With Ukraine - **UK** secures access to **Ukraine's Avengers AI Labs** for advanced military AI development.
Project Gigabit Updates - New transparency data released on **Project Gigabit** contracts for broadband expansion in the UK.
Space Protection Insights - **NSpOC** reports increased satellite re-entries but lower collision risks for UK-licensed satellites in July.
DSIT Workforce Data - Latest **DSIT** workforce management information reveals departmental staff numbers and payroll for July 2026.
Digital Sector Employment Stats - New estimates on employment in the **digital sector** highlight job trends for 2025.
